title: 陈佳怡九年级错题练习（英语）
subject: 英语

questions.stem: —____ you ____ your homework yet? —Yes, I finished it ten minutes ago.
questions.analysis: yet 是现在完成时标志词，结构 have/has + done

questions.stem: A lot of trees ____ around our school last spring.
questions.analysis: last spring过去时间；树木是“被种植”，一般过去时被动语态

questions.stem: Could you tell me ____ he will come here tomorrow?
questions.analysis: if 此处意为“是否”，引导宾语从句

questions.stem: You ____ smoke in the library. It’s against the rules.
I enjoy ____ books in my free time.
questions.analysis: 固定搭配 enjoy doing sth.

questions.stem: My brother usually goes to school ____ bike.
There is ____ “u” and ____ “s” in the word “useful”.
questions.analysis: u辅音音素开头用a；s元音音素开头用an

questions.stem: —Who is that girl? —____ is my cousin.
questions.analysis: 句子缺主语，用人称代词主格she

questions.stem: I didn’t go to the park ____ it rained heavily yesterday.
questions.analysis: because引导原因状语从句，解释原因

questions.stem: He ____ in this factory since 2020.
The letter ____ by my sister yesterday afternoon.
Do you know ____ he likes best?
questions.analysis: what在宾语从句中作like的宾语，喜欢什么

questions.stem: —____ I borrow your pen? —Sure, here you are.
questions.analysis: may 用于委婉请求许可

questions.stem: She decided ____ to Beijing for her holiday.
questions.analysis: decide to do sth. 决定做某事

questions.stem: We will have a picnic if it ____ fine tomorrow.
questions.analysis: if条件状语从句，主将从现

questions.stem: —When did you arrive ____ the station? —At 9 p.m.
____ moon goes around ____ earth.
questions.analysis: 独一无二天体前加定冠词the

questions.stem: This is not my bag. ____ is on the desk.
____ he is young, he knows a lot.
questions.analysis: though虽然，引导让步状语从句

questions.stem: Look! The children ____ games on the playground.
questions.analysis: look! 是现在进行时标志

questions.stem: Many new houses ____ in the village every year.
questions.analysis: every year一般现在时被动语态

questions.stem: I want to know ____ you get to school every morning.
You ____ hurry. There is plenty of time.
He is good at ____ English songs.
questions.analysis: be good at doing sth. 擅长做某事

questions.stem: I ____ call you as soon as I get home.
questions.analysis: as soon as 一…就，主将从现

questions.stem: They will leave ____ Monday morning.
—Do you have ____ dictionary? —Yes, I have one.
Help ____ to some fruit, kids.
questions.analysis: help oneself 随便吃，kids复数用yourselves

questions.stem: I was late, ____ I missed the early bus.
My father ____ to Shanghai twice.
questions.analysis: has been to 去过某地（已经回来）

questions.stem: A nice picture ____ on the wall just now.
She asked me ____ I had been to Nanjing.
—____ I take this book out of the library? —No, you can’t.
Remember ____ your notebook tomorrow.
questions.analysis: remember to do 记得要去做（还没做）

questions.stem: If you ____ harder, you will pass the exam.
questions.analysis: 主将从现，从句一般现在时

questions.stem: We usually have a holiday ____ summer.
He is ____ honest boy. We all trust him.
—Whose ruler is this? —It’s ____.
You can’t watch TV ____ you finish your homework.
My sister ____ TV when I got home yesterday.
This kind of cake ____ very well.
questions.analysis: sell 表“卖得好”用主动形式表被动含义

questions.stem: Could you tell me ____ the nearest bank is?
We ____ eat or drink in class. It’s a rule.
Stop ____! The teacher is coming.
questions.analysis: stop doing 停止正在做的事

questions.stem: I will go hiking with you ____ it doesn’t rain.
questions.analysis: if 如果，条件状语从句

questions.stem: He came back ____ ten o’clock last night.
____ Greens are having dinner now.
Neither you nor he ____ good at drawing.
I like English ____ it is interesting.
We ____ already ____ our classroom.
questions.analysis: already现在完成时标志，主语we用have

questions.stem: The old building ____ next year.
questions.analysis: next year将来时被动：will be done

questions.stem: Do you know ____ book this is?
—Must I finish the task today? —No, you ____.
My mother asked me ____ too much time playing games.
analysis: ask sb. not to do 要求某人不要做某事
questions.analysis: ask sb. not to do sth.

questions.stem: She will call you as soon as she ____ Beijing.
questions.analysis: as soon as 主将从现，she三单

questions.stem: We have no classes ____ Sunday.
There is ____ orange on the table.
The two girls are helping ____.
questions.analysis: each other 互相（两者之间）

questions.stem: ____ he was tired, he kept working.
My brother ____ the bike for three years.
A speech ____ in our school hall tomorrow.
I don’t know ____ he will choose.
You ____ take an umbrella. It is going to rain.
He looks forward to ____ the new movie.
questions.analysis: look forward to doing 盼望做某事，to是介词

questions.stem: You will miss the bus ____ you hurry up.
We arrived ____ Beijing yesterday afternoon.
____ man under the tree is my uncle.
Not only Tom but also his parents ____ interested in sports.
questions.analysis: not only…but also 就近原则，parents复数

questions.stem: I was hungry, ____ I made myself a sandwich.
—Where is Tom? —He ____ to the library.
questions.analysis: has gone to去了某地还没回来

questions.stem: Rice ____ in the south of China.
questions.analysis: 水稻是被种植，一般现在被动

questions.stem: Tell me ____ you met at the party last night.
We ____ speak loudly in the hospital.
He practiced ____ English every morning.
questions.analysis: practice doing sth. 练习做某事

questions.stem: The meeting will be put off ____ it rains tomorrow.
questions.analysis: if 如果，条件状语从句

questions.stem: I usually get up ____ 6:30 a.m.
It takes me ____ hour to get there.
All of us enjoyed ____ at the party.
I will wait for you ____ you come back.
She ____ this book since last month.
The letter ____ tomorrow.
Could you tell me ____ the train leaves?
You ____ worry about her. She is old enough.
My father told me ____ in the river. It’s dangerous.
questions.analysis: tell sb. not to do sth.

questions.stem: If it ____ sunny tomorrow, we will go boating.
We have a math test ____ Friday afternoon.
____ earth goes around the sun.
There are many trees on ____ sides of the road.
He didn’t go to school ____ he was ill.
questions.analysis: because生病是不去上学的原因

questions.stem: They ____ here for 5 years.
This song ____ by a famous singer last year.
I want to know ____ you like best, tea or coffee.
—Can I use your phone? —Yes, you ____.
She spent two hours ____ her homework.
I won’t go out ____ I finish cleaning my room.
They will fly to Chengdu ____ July.
He is ____ useful student in our class.
Either you or your sister ____ late for class.
____ it rained heavily, we still went hiking.
I ____ the film twice. It’s really good.
questions.analysis: twice两次，现在完成时，强调经历
